Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As the Director of Engineering for RF Systems at Harmattan AI, you will act as a vital management layer between R&D modules and leadership, focusing on elevating our people and standardising our engineering excellence. This is a "hands-off" people management role designed to relieve pressure on senior leadership by building high-performing teams, improving internal tooling, and standardising work processes across the company without sacrificing execution speed. You will be a visionary partner to our leadership, contributing to organisational structure and the long-term technical vision. In this role, you will lead our RF Systems teams in Paris — covering radar, radio, and electronic warfare. This is research-heavy, defence-critical engineering at the boundary of physics and product, operating under cleared-environment constraints that differ from commercial work. Responsibilities People Management & Mentorship: Act as a dedicated people manager for engineers, overseeing performance reviews, career growth, and training initiatives. Recruitment: Own the recruitment process as the number one priority, building and maintaining an effective engineering team to meet our ambitious growth plans in a scarce, cleared-defence RF and EW talent market. Process Standardisation: Develop and implement standardised work processes across radar, radio, EW, and signal-processing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency. Engineering Infrastructure: Audit and improve internal tooling—deciding between off-the-shelf and custom solutions—to ensure engineers have the best resources to succeed. Organisational Strategy: Contribute to the organisational structure by reorganising modules and initiating changes to optimise cross-functional (XFN) delivery. Vision & Execution: Collaborate with leadership to build the company vision, bringing fresh ideas to the table rather than just executing existing plans. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record in Electrical Engineering, RF, Signal Processing, or a related technical field. Proven Leadership: Previous experience as an Individual Contributor (IC) who has successfully transitioned into a management role, allowing you to deeply understand the technical challenges your team faces. Experience: Direct experience leading radar, RF, electronic warfare, or RF navigation engineering teams in a defence prime or cleared-environment scale-up. You have led at least one programme through qualification under MIL-STD, NATO STANAG, or TEMPEST discipline. Fluent French and English required; active or recent cleared status (FR, NL, UK, or EU equivalent) is a strong plus. Technical Engagement: While this is a management-focused role, you should still possess a desire to "keep your hands dirty" and remain engaged with the technical aspects of the work. Soft Skills & Communication: Exceptional soft skills and communication abilities, with a "high-bar" for excellence and a natural ability to elevate those around them. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of building autonomous defence systems and a readiness to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

review_candidates.title: Director of Engineering
review_candidates.description: Department: Engineering Location: Kingdom of Bahrain - Manama Description The Director of Engineering oversees the technical hand-over, operational testing, commissioning, and long-term facility preservation of the luxury property. During the pre-opening phase, this role serves as the primary technical liaison between project developers, consultants, contractors, local authorities, and the hotel operating team. The position ensures that all MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing), HVAC, life safety systems, structural assets, and high-spec luxury amenities (such as infinity pools, sky lounges, and spa facilities) are delivered to Kempinski standards, local municipal regulations, and corporate sustainability guidelines before opening to guests. Key Responsibilities How You Will Make a Difference; What We’re Looking For Pre-Opening, Commissioning & Handover Represent the operator in all site inspections, snagging processes, testing, and commissioning of physical plant, MEP equipment, vertical transportation (elevators), and life safety infrastructure. Review architectural and MEP drawings, operational operation & maintenance (O&M) manuals, warranty agreements, and as-built plans prior to property acceptance. Coordinate system performance evaluations alongside main contractors to verify compliance with local environmental. Establish asset registries and implement a computerised maintenance management system (CMMS) or Property Management Maintenance System (PMMS) from scratch. Departmental Operations & Team Leadership Build, recruit, and structure the engineering department, selecting qualified shift engineers, technicians, and specialized craftsmen. Develop Departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), emergency response workflows, and safety protocols in line with corporate standards. Establish preventive maintenance programs (PMP) for all major equipment, guest rooms, public spaces, back-of-house (BOH) zones, and exterior infrastructure. Conduct technical and life-safety training programs for engineering staff and cross-departmental teams. Financial, Energy & Sustainability Management Prepare and manage the engineering operating budget, capital expenditure (CapEx) plan, pre-opening departmental launch budgets, and utility consumption models. Monitor energy, water, and fuel usage; design and implement energy-saving and carbon-reduction initiatives. Negotiate, execute, and monitor third-party service and maintenance contracts (e.g., chillers, fire suppression systems, elevators, pool maintenance, high-voltage systems). Safety, Compliance & Asset Protection Serve as the hotel’s lead technical authority on Fire, Life, and Safety (FLS) systems, ensuring total readiness for internal audits and municipal certifications. Implement risk management policies to protect the physical asset against environmental degradation, water damage, electrical risks, and structural wear. Oversee sustainability compliance (e.g., EarthCheck or equivalent certification programs required by corporate standards). Skills, Knowledge and Expertise What Makes You a Great Fit; Who We’re Looking For Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services, or a related technical discipline. Experience: Minimum 5–8 years as a Director of Engineering / Chief Engineer in a 5-star luxury hotel or integrated resort environment. Demonstrated track record in a pre-opening capacity (taking a hotel property from construction phase/handover through to operational launch). Regional Experience: Middle East / GCC market experience highly preferred; familiarity with Bahrain Civil Defence, EWA regulations, and local vendor ecosystems is a strong advantage. Technical Mastery: Deep knowledge of central HVAC plant operations, BMS systems, desalination/water treatment, emergency generators, high-voltage networks, and advanced FLS protocols. Languages: Business fluency in English is mandatory; conversational Arabic is a plus. Competencies: Strong contractor management capabilities, commercial budget planning, Crisis Management Leadership, and cross-functional team management. Why Join Kempinski Kempinski emphasises talent development and offers career progression within its global network, with properties in over 30 countries. There are opportunities to work in diverse cultural environments whilst continuing your professional growth. We are proud to foster a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and are empowered to deliver exceptional guest experiences. Be part of a legacy, build your future. Discover the possibilities at Kempinski.
